name: Hoshino Mitsuki
source:
Mitsuki was always very withdrawn... until the world essentially ended. Now, she gives zero fucks, and is intent on making Akemi pay for making years of her life hell. The stigma surrounding her has continued despite the bullying at her hands being long over, isolating her to the point that Chiaki is her only friend.

Favorite Color: Yellow
Blood Type: B+
